title: Beyond No: Quantifying AI Over-Refusal and Emotional Attachment Boundaries
benchmark_measurement: This paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The benchmark measures emotional boundary handling, over-refusal, and emotional attachment in Large Language Models.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as this was not a focus of the research.
